title: Basalt

description.en: Dense, dark, durable. A matte design system for information-rich software.
description.zh: 沉稳、紧凑的哑光设计系统，为信息密集的软件界面而做。

websiteSource: GitHub repository homepage and README at 9e226aa5c1376351ec76a659b1a33a8139892b4b
subject: Obsidian and gemstone Forbidden City corner tower

source.description: Matte-dark design system engineered for high-density SaaS interfaces

subject.en: A candy-colored Forbidden City corner tower on white Hanbaiyu marble
subject.zh: 汉白玉基座上的糖果色故宫角楼

description.en: The three-quarter view, tiered roofs, upturned eaves, finial and low square foundation preserve the earlier tower. One uniform 80% placement gives every architectural tip room inside the rounded tile; the nearest visible feature sits about 220 native pixels from its boundary.
description.zh: 保留原有斜向镜头、层叠屋顶、飞檐、宝顶和低方基座。整座角楼统一按 80% 放入圆角取景框，最近的可见边缘也留有约 220 个原生像素的空间。

description.en: Opaque white marble replaces the black plinth and balustrade. Blue and green roof surfaces, pink columns, pearl structure and yellow-gold details translate Basalt’s existing candy palette into a crafted miniature. Veining, latticework and small bevels retain physical depth under broad studio light.
description.zh: 白色汉白玉替换黑色基座与栏杆；蓝绿屋面、粉色立柱、珍珠色构件与金黄细节，把 Basalt 现有糖果色板转化为精工微缩建筑。石材纹理、窗棂和小倒角在宽柔光下保留真实层次。

description.en: The existing Basalt field keeps fine engineering cells, larger datum lines, spare roof elevations and dimensional ticks. Independent projected shadows lift the marble base gently from the paper. The transparent master contains the complete tower without the field, grain or cast shadow.
description.zh: 沿用 Basalt 的细工程格线、较大基准线、疏朗屋顶立面与尺寸刻度。独立投影让汉白玉基座轻轻悬于纸面；透明母版只保留完整角楼，不含底色、颗粒或外部投影。

palette.source: Selected local Basalt presentation, 2026-09-08-01/01; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: At 128/64 px the colored roof tiers and white marble foundation remain distinct. At 32/24/16 px the mark relies on its blue-and-green stepped silhouette; latticework, veining and gold beads merge. The pale foundation softens on light interfaces, while sidebar and favicon specimens retain the transparent foreground.
sizeNote.zh: 128/64 px 下可分辨彩色重檐与白色石台；32/24/16 px 主要依靠蓝绿层叠轮廓，窗棂、石纹与金珠会合并。浅色界面上的白色基座会柔化，侧栏与 favicon 样例仍使用透明前景。

goal.en: Give React applications a consistent set of controls, layered surfaces, charts, and page layouts.
goal.zh: 为 React 应用提供统一的控件、分层表面、图表和页面布局。

role.zh: 设计 tokens 与独立样式

description.en: Datum lines, roof-elevation strokes and dimension ticks recall the precision behind the corner tower.
description.zh: 基准线、屋顶立面笔画与尺寸刻度，呼应角楼结构背后的精密秩序。

alt.en: A candy-colored Forbidden City corner tower on white Hanbaiyu marble on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 汉白玉基座上的糖果色故宫角楼，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.zh: 为密集的信息，打下稳固基础。

description.en: Candy-colored Forbidden City corner tower on white Hanbaiyu marble.
description.zh: 汉白玉基座上的糖果色故宫角楼。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥76px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 76px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
